description: An Indosat Ooredoo subscriber and Mandiri Priority banking customer in Jakarta Selatan was targeted by a SIM swap attack orchestrated through social engineering of the mobile operator's customer service hotline. The attacker, posing as the victim using personal data obtained from a data breach of an Indonesian e-commerce platform, convinced the operator to transfer the number to a new SIM. Within 90 minutes of the swap, the attacker authenticated into Mandiri Online, passed the OTP verification, and initiated a Mandiri transfer of IDR 250,000,000 to a CIMB Niaga account. The CIMB Niaga destination account was opened the same morning using an e-KTP from a different region, consistent with a mule account. The victim only discovered the fraud when attempting to call a contact and receiving a 'number not active' message.
